# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering fixes** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157 previews Skia m157 with fixes for rasterization, GPU text and transformed geometry. The release also corrects Graphite readback and clipping, improves Vulkan error handling, and makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Graphite Metal users should review the native iOS and tvOS minimum below.

## Breaking Changes

- **Require iOS or tvOS 15 for Graphite Metal** — Graphite Metal now requires a native runtime minimum of iOS or tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise your deployment target when using this backend. Any higher managed or framework platform minimum still applies. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 157** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m157 while preserving the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **More accurate transformed geometry** — Corrects reflected square caps on zero-length hairlines, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle radii and stroke widths, and overlapping corner radii. Also fixes convex-path device-space bounds and software coverage-mask clamping. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **More reliable GPU glyph replay** — Validates direct-mask Slug data on deserialization and drawing, handles unsupported fractional replay, and rounds text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture. Empty Ganesh flushes no longer leave stale atlas work. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Graphite clipping and GPU filter correctness** — Fixes Graphite alpha-to-RGBx readback stride, clip-key packing and wedge inflation. Clip draws count toward pass capacity; oversized clip stacks warn and skip the draw. Displacement-filter offsets use full precision to match their computed bounds. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Vulkan synchronization and cleanup** — Corrects render-pass pointer initialization and delays device-loss cleanup by 1 ms for ARM proprietary drivers >=42 and <56. Failed fence waits now fail native synchronous submission; managed GRContext.Submit remains void and does not expose that result. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Explicit cdecl for LibraryImport** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now match the cdecl convention of existing DllImport and delegate paths across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp and companion bindings. This addresses an ABI mismatch on Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## Security

- **Convex path rasterization bounds** — Fixes a native heap overflow when anti-aliased convex paths cross vertical clip gaps. ([#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths. This corrects a potential Windows x86 ABI mismatch without changing public APIs or native exports; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 13, 2026)

Release Candidate 2 corrects transformed Ganesh geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip-capacity accounting. It also aligns displacement offsets with filter bounds and propagates failed Vulkan fence waits through native synchronous submission, without adding managed failure reporting.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline square caps and GPU text-atlas selection. It also delays device-loss cleanup for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, subject to any higher framework minimum.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.1...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
